title: world-set
description: A set W of worlds over which the modal structure on a knowledge presheaf is indexed; generated by a settling bound, it may take the settling ordinals lambda themselves as worlds (W = lambda) or be a separate index set chosen for the modal application.

worlds.description: the underlying set W of worlds indexing the modal structure on a knowledge presheaf

indexes-modal-structure.description: each world in W indexes a fiber of the knowledge presheaf for the modal application

may-be-settling-bound.description: true when W = lambda, taking the settling ordinals of the settling bound as worlds; false when W is a separate index set
